title: Oli Hammond (Partner, Fuel Ventures) — 'My usual rule is that I don't read industry books, only fiction, but will be making an exception here'
summary: Early-stage investor Oli Hammond — Partner at Fuel Ventures, backing UK tech founders — posts a distinctive Prosper breakfast reaction (22 likes): he only reads fiction, not industry books, but is making an exception for Incorruptible.
blockquote: Thanks to Eric Ries and Prosper for hosting me today for breakfast. My usual rule is that I don't read industry books, only fiction, but will be making an exception here.
